title: Twice As Small
prompt:
**Bài toán.** Count the pairs i < j with a[i] > 2·a[j].

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n ≤ 200000; |a[i]| ≤ 10^9.

**Output:** one integer (64-bit).

tests.name: none
simple
negatives
n=200000
tests.hint: Full scale: O(n²) is 2·10^10 — times out; compression + Fenwick counts in O(n log n). Ground truth in Python via sorted-list bisection.
